item.title: Peoria man in custody in connection with Sunday night collision with a house
item.description: A 20-year-old Peoria man was arrested for failing to remain at the scene of a crash and resisting arrest after a car struck a house, and was also found to have an outstanding warrant in connection with a 2023 shooting case.

item.title: Neighborhood House congregate meal site opens at East Peoria retirement center
item.description: Neighborhood House has opened a new congregate meal site at the Mel Hasty Retirement Center in East Peoria, providing seniors with a space to socialize and eat nutritious meals together.

item.title: Peoria County Sheriff's deputy shot as he rounded corner, prosecutor says
item.description: Deputy Jack Evans was shot by 51-year-old suspect, who was charged with five felony counts including attempted first-degree murder, after a foot chase that began when the suspect ran from a traffic stop.

item.title: Peoria County undersheriff leads with integrity and empathy
item.description: Undersheriff Carmisha Turner of the Peoria County Sheriff's Office prioritizes the safety of her staff and detainees, values the dedication of her team, and holds education and health advocacy in high regard through her work with Living to Serve Foundation.

item.title: Morton financial advisor on Trump Accounts: could 'supercharge savings for kids'
item.description: Trump Accounts, new long-term investment accounts for children under 18, are launching on July 5th, with a potential $1,000 contribution from the US government for those born between Jan 1st and Dec 31st, 2028, to help supercharge savings for kids going into adulthood.

item.title: Normal reassures residents on fire station 2 relocation
item.description: The town of Normal held a council meeting to address concerns about the relocation of Fire Station 2, and explained that the new location's response time remains within the targeted four to six-minute range.

item.title: Peoria County deputy in 'stable condition' after Saturday night shooting, sheriff says
item.description: Deputy Jack Evans, 24, was shot in both legs and his torso after a traffic stop on Saturday night and is in good spirits while remaining under medical care.

item.title: 5-5 vote continues Peoria City legal challenge with Boyd Gaming
item.description: The Peoria City Council voted 5-5 to reject a measure that would have ended their legal challenge to a proposed casino in East Peoria, with Mayor Rita Ali expressing disappointment and warning that the city could end up with "literally nothing" if they continue to fight the legal battle.

item.title: Peoria school basketball coach arrested for allegedly soliciting a minor
item.description: A Peoria Public School employee, Daniel C. Ruffin, was arrested for indecent solicitation of a 16-year-old female student after inappropriate text messages were found on the girl's phone.
